in_hebrew.name: Hun
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Proto-Germanic word ‘hunjan’, meaning ‘to hunt’. The name Hun was popular among the ancient Hungarians and has been used throughout history in various cultures.
